entities.summary: Biostatistics is a branch of statistics that applies statistical methods to a wide range of topics in the biological sciences, with a focus on clinical medicine and public health applications. The field encompasses the design of experiments, the collection and analysis of experimental and observational data, and the interpretation of the results. It is closely related to medical statistics.
